title: Mnemonic Body-Artifact 3D Separation

availability.meaning: The five-layer scene contract and validator remain active. GarmentForge now supplies retained detachable textiles, embedded PBR weave, skinning, re-dressing states, and bounded secondary textile motion. A production mnemonic body reconstruction runtime and continuum cloth solver are not claimed.
must_not_claim: Do not claim a full mnemonic reconstruction runtime from the contract or garment runtime alone.
Do not claim continuum cloth simulation, tailoring-grade pattern generation, or a production human reconstruction rig.
Do not flatten conflicting body and artifact evidence into one canonical scene.

acceptance: Body and garment object identifiers are disjoint.
Every major object has provenance and confidence.
Interactions reference existing body and artifact objects.
At least one unresolved or alternative hypothesis is preserved when conflicts exist.
The scene declares reopen and reuse checks for pose, garment state, or camera variation.
Garment-bearing scenes reference detachable GarmentForge assets rather than baking clothing into embodied geometry.
remaining_runtime_gate: bind reconstructed or production body rigs to the validated garment runtime
execute fitted garment response against body collision proxies
reopen a mnemonic retained scene and render a second camera and pose
emit a completion receipt using the command-center evidence schema
